vat.summary: German VAT (Umsatzsteuer / Mehrwertsteuer). Standard 19%, reduced 7% — confirm before quoting a return.

payroll.summary: German payroll is Lohnsteuer plus social insurance (KV, RV, AV, PV). Use DATEV / the payroll product. Do not apply UK PAYE tables.

facts.note: Church tax may also apply. Read the books.
